headline: Since the Tuesday 18:00 brief: about 199 releases (v0.1.1033 to v0.1.1232). Web Summit called off Day 2 on the government's advice, and the site followed it overnight. At your word this morning, the home page now leads with the storm and today, with a live sources strip at the top linking the storm site and Lisbon Fringe. dev@ and dev.pages@ came back at 18:30 and carried The Front Page onto every page. The one block: the shared OpenRouter credit is spent.
